reading.body:
This facility publishes no power capacity, square footage, or technical specifications. The operator's own public locations page does not list a specific address, and industry aggregators do not carry details. Research confirms this is a private internal corporate data center rather than a marketed colocation or cloud facility, positioned near the operator's Westlake headquarters established in 2021.

Without published power or IT load figures, this campus cannot be ranked among Texas facilities by compute capacity. Texas has 133 mapped data centers, of which only 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 MW. This facility is not among those 18 published figures.

The absence of published specifications reflects the operator's apparent posture of proprietary control over the facility rather than third-party hosting or marketed services. No certification details are published. For readers assessing where compute capacity sits in the grid, this campus remains opaque.
